fields.Name: IT94 - MetadataSync Push Atomicity
fields.Description: mj sync push against the live database (mutation tier, RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1), through PushService on throwaway scratch trees. MSP1 an atomic push (the default) that fails in its second folder rolls back the first folder's update and create and reports nothing committed (#4550). MSP2 a record that fails without throwing (missing primary key, autoCreateMissingRecords=false) stops the push and rolls it back; later folders never run. MSP3 an Action with nested Action Params pushes atomically without the #4290 hang. MSP4 a failed non-atomic push (atomic: false) lists exactly the records that stayed committed, and they are in the database. Every row is prefixed zzz-it94 and deleted in teardown. Server transport.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A failed atomic push leaves the database and the metadata files unchanged, counted record errors stop the push, nested Action Param graphs push atomically, and a failed non-atomic push reports exactly what stayed committed.
